title: Remove all user cron jobs
summary: Delete all scheduled commands for your current user. This action is irreversible unless you have a backup.

steps.explain: Remove all entries from your user's crontab.

rollback.explain: You cannot automatically undo this. You must manually re-add your jobs using 'crontab -e' if you know what they were.

warnings: This deletes all your scheduled jobs permanently. Ensure you have a backup if you might need them later.
